facts.raw_span: A 27-year-old man
history of a 5 mm‐thick melanoma on his posterior neck
treated six years earlier by wide local excision
presented with hemoptysis and dyspnea
Vital signs were within normal limits
Physical examination was notable only for scattered breath sounds without stridor
Laboratory studies, including complete blood count and metabolic panel, were unremarkable
Contrast-enhanced CT of the chest revealed a 3.1 × 2.7 × 3.6 cm mass in the right lower lobe
Endobronchial ultrasound–guided fine-needle aspiration of the lung lesion demonstrated a malignant small round blue cell tumor
Molecular studies were negative for an EWSR1 translocation but otherwise were interpreted as consistent with Ewing sarcoma/primitive neuroectodermal tumor (PNET)
Positron emission tomography (PET)/CT showed an FDG-avid right lower lobe mass
Mid-treatment PET/CT demonstrated a substantial decrease in size and complete metabolic response of the lung mass

concepts.why: Molecular studies were consistent with Ewing sarcoma/primitive neuroectodermal tumor (PNET) and the patient presented with a malignant small round blue cell tumor
The patient presented with a lung mass and a hyoid bone lesion, which could be metastases from the primary Ewing sarcoma
The patient presented with a hyoid bone lesion, which could be a primary bone tumor
The patient presented with a hyoid bone lesion, which could be a plasmacytoma
The patient presented with a hyoid bone lesion, which could be a chondrosarcoma
The patient presented with a hyoid bone lesion, which could be an osteosarcoma
The patient presented with a lung mass, which could be a metastasis from the primary Ewing sarcoma
The patient presented with a lung mass, which could be a primary pulmonary tumor
The hyoid bone lesion showed interval growth despite chemotherapy, suggesting a distinct pathology that is resistant to the treatment given.

rationales.F08: The presence of a lung mass is more typical of metastatic disease or a primary lung tumor.
rationales.F09: The diagnosis of a malignant small round blue cell tumor is highly suggestive of Ewing sarcoma.
rationales.F10: The molecular studies consistent with Ewing sarcoma provide strong evidence for this diagnosis.
rationales.F12: The complete metabolic response of the lung mass to treatment suggests that it was not a treatment-resistant tumor.
